purpose: Preparation-only A2 identity safety corpus. It defines observable safety expectations, not an implementation.

scenarios.setup: A bound OBS resource has a stable UUID and a human-readable name.
scenarios.event: The resource is renamed while the UUID remains unchanged.
safety_expectations: A rename alone must not silently retarget the binding to another object.
Diagnostics should surface the new display name without treating the old name as durable identity.

scenarios.setup: A profile references an OBS object whose UUID is known.
scenarios.event: The object is deleted and a new object is created with the same name but a different UUID.
safety_expectations: The replacement must never be silently adopted from name equality alone.
Mutation must block or require an explicit migration/rebind.

scenarios.setup: Two Scene Items in one container reference sources with the same display name.
safety_expectations: Name alone is insufficient to authorize a mutation.
If the intended physical occurrence cannot be proven uniquely, the mutation must fail closed.

scenarios.setup: Several same-name Scene Items are present and the intended occurrence was previously bound.
scenarios.event: The Scene Items are reordered without changing the logical profile.
safety_expectations: Occurrence index alone must not authorize writing to a different physical Scene Item.
SSR must revalidate identity or block before mutation.

scenarios.setup: A Scene Item binding was prepared from a valid catalog snapshot.
scenarios.event: OBS rebuilds or renumbers Scene Item IDs after structural edits.
safety_expectations: A cached sceneItemId is only an optimization, never durable identity.
SSR must resolve and verify the intended object again before writing.

scenarios.setup: A prepared operation belongs to Scene Collection A.
scenarios.event: OBS switches A to B and back to A before the operation commits.
safety_expectations: Matching the final collection name is insufficient proof of continuity.
The prepared operation must be invalidated or requalified before mutation.

scenarios.setup: A prepared operation is bound to one OBS transport/session generation.
scenarios.event: The WebSocket session reconnects while OBS remains on a collection with the same name.
safety_expectations: The previous prepared binding must not survive the session-generation change.
Fresh observation/binding is required before any mutation.

scenarios.setup: A legacy profile contains only name/occurrence style references and no durable identity metadata.
scenarios.event: A2 loads or migrates the profile against the current OBS collection.
safety_expectations: Migration may enrich identity only when the target is uniquely provable.
Ambiguous legacy references remain blocked and are reported for explicit repair.

scenarios.setup: The target Scene Item is inside a nested group topology.
scenarios.event: The group tree changes or the item is moved between containers.
safety_expectations: Container identity is part of the binding proof.
A stale path/container binding must not authorize a write in the new topology.
